scope.policy: Independent CEFR-aligned B1 teaching inventory, with the Goethe-Zertifikat B1 list used only as a level-classification reference.
scope.identityPolicy: Opaque row IDs remain temporarily stable during editorial work; the release migration step rekeys changed lexemes before publication.
scope.duplicatePolicy: No term and normalized part-of-speech pair duplicates the released A1 or A2 inventories or any hand-edited card.
scope.editorialPolicy: Every headword, morphology line, modern Simplified-Chinese meaning, German example, and Chinese translation was reviewed as one teaching unit.
